ruleDefinitions.name: Active Directory Parsing DLL Loaded Via Office Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects DSParse DLL being loaded by an Office Product Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mspub\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenote\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenoteim\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$")) AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\dsparse\\\.dll.*"))
